g.title: ID: task_source Responsibility: Provide task intent and acceptance context. Owner: Operator or task system Runtime: Issue, ticket, chat, or manual request State variables: task_ref; acceptance_contract Invariants: Task intent is retained. ID: agent_runtime Responsibility: Produce model decisions, tool calls, edits, and bounded outputs. Owner: Agent runtime operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: run_id; trace_id; tool_call_id Invariants: Runtime events carry source identity and run identity. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

ID: source_adapters Responsibility: Translate provider records into bounded canonical events. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: source_event_id; adapter_version; idempotency_key Invariants: Provider-specific differences do not change canonical identity fields. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: canonicalizer Responsibility: Redact secrets, classify sensitivity, canonicalize payloads, and compute digests. Owner: Security and Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: redaction_status; sensitivity; payload_sha256 Invariants: Secrets are blocked before durable persistence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: provenance_ledger Responsibility: Store typed facts, JSONB payloads, stable identities, and critical relationships. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL State variables: run_id; event_id; repository_id; commit_sha; checkpoint_id Invariants: Critical references satisfy relational constraints.; Facts are append-only or dispositioned. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-constraints.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: artifact_store Responsibility: Store large logs, diffs, traces, and transcripts behind access control. Owner: Platform operator Runtime: Content-addressed object storage State variables: artifact_sha256; uri; sensitivity; retention_class Invariants: Digest and access policy remain attached to every artifact. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_broker Responsibility: Return bounded project-specific evidence and lessons to a review or agent run. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Read-only Node.js API or MCP tool State variables: request_scope; head_sha; packet_digest; access_decision Invariants: Context is scoped to the requester, project, repository, and exact head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: codex_review Responsibility: Interpret bounded evidence, identify risks, and propose review findings. Owner: Review operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: review_id; head_sha; finding_ids Invariants: Codex review does not replace deterministic gates or human approval. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-review.mjs:1#review command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

ID: human_approver Responsibility: Own accepted risk, privacy decisions, and promotion approval. Owner: Assigned human owner Runtime: Review interface State variables: decision; approver; decision_time Invariants: The system never fabricates human approval. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

text.tspan: Agent trace event / trace export or bounded event API
Persist fact and relationships / PostgreSQL transaction
Store large content by digest / content-addressed object API
Resolve exact facts and digests / read-only PostgreSQL query
Provide bounded review context / MCP or read-only API
Review findings and outcome / validated review event API
